headline:
Strong run,
valuation catching up fast
chart_note: 10-day range: $146.58 - $154.33, part of a 25% run over the past month - down slightly today.
why_today: Down slightly today after a 25% run over the past month - merchant revenue and earnings both accelerating well above overall e-commerce growth.
pro_1: Revenue up 34% and earnings up 68% YoY, with analyst sentiment strongly positive (40 Buy/Strong Buy vs. 11 Hold)
pro_2: Consistent execution on GMV growth as more merchants build on the platform
con_1: Up 25% in a single month - a lot of good news may already be reflected in the price
con_2: Beta of 2.59 and a 103x trailing P/E mean this can swing hard in either direction
